product_summary: Manufacturer (own R&D centre, own plant claimed) of five product families per fineorgokem.com: (1) Synthetic Resins - polyamide resins co-solvent soluble, alcohol soluble, reactive (epoxy curing agents), and ketonic resin for inks/paints; (2) Automotive Additive Packages - LubeAdd 4T, 2T, PCMO, HDDO; (3) Industrial Additive Packages - LubeAdd soluble cutting oil emulsifier, rust preventive additive, thermic & quenching additive, neat cutting oil additive; (4) Industrial Fuel - FinoFuel-90 blended thermic oil fuel from vegetable-based oil; (5) Fino Mosquito Larvicidal Oil FLO-90. Also listed in site menu: metal working fluids components, antifoam, viscosity index improver. Address: 6th Floor, Sharda Terraces, CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra 400614.
comment: Declared 381119/381121 covers only the lubricant additive-package part of the range and is therefore PARTIAL, not wrong. 381121 (additives containing petroleum oils) is plausible for LubeAdd 4T/2T/PCMO/HDDO packages; 381119 is a residual subheading that does not fit the emulsifier/rust-preventive/thermic-quenching/neat-cutting-oil additives, which belong in 381129 or 381190. Two whole product lines are missing from the declaration: synthetic resins (polyamide 3908.90, ketonic resin) and fuels/larvicidal oil (FinoFuel-90, FLO-90). Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is a misclassification - the company is a specialty chemicals / lubricant-additive and synthetic-resin maker, not oil & gas; no upstream or downstream petroleum activity is shown on the site. No trader signs found: own brand names (LubeAdd, FinoFuel, FLO-90), own R&D centre and plant are claimed, so role = manufacturer. Per Rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is kept, codes corrected to the actual product mix, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product facts above come from the company's own website pages (fineorgokem.com home, /synthetic-resin, /industrial-additive-packages, /automotive-additive-package, /industrial-fuel, /fino-mosquito-larvicidal-oil) - these are catalogue claims only, so every HS mapping is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' until matched against a customs line; no shipment, B-L or GST record was checked in this task. Exact HS-6 for ketonic resin and for FLO-90 cannot be verified from public data (null) and must be fixed against the actual customs description.
